# op8x

> op8x builds free tools for x402 sellers (APIs that get paid over HTTP 402).

op8x does not hold customer funds and is not a facilitator. Every check op8x publishes states its method, target list, result, date and denominator, so it can be re-derived.

## Status

- 402 analytics for sellers: in development
- Verified first purchase: planned
- Badge: planned
